subject.title: fix(update): backport config migration ordering to 2026.7.2

question: Should the 2026.7.2 release branch take the already-merged main migration-order fix so stable installs with shipped nested Discord DM settings can update without manual configuration repair?
rationale: This is a deliberate release-branch inclusion that invokes automatic persisted-config repair during updates; only a release owner can decide whether that upgrade behavior belongs in the candidate.
